storeUrl.description: Public HTTPS store root or WordPress installation path.

keyword.description: Search within this store; at most 200 characters.

categoryId.description: Restrict to a public product category.

calculatePriceRange.description: Calculate this aggregate; default true. Unsupported store fields may be null.

calculateRatingCounts.description: Calculate this aggregate; default true. Unsupported store fields may be null.

calculateStockStatusCounts.description: Calculate this aggregate; default true. Unsupported store fields may be null.

attributeTaxonomies.description: Attribute taxonomies to count, using OR semantics, for example pa_color. Default empty.

taxonomies.description: Public taxonomies to count; default empty. Store support varies.
